description: This Java source file defines the ExternalAnyKeyboard class, which extends the AnyKeyboard class and implements the HardKeyboardTranslator interface. It manages keyboard layout, translation mappings, and key popup configurations for an Android soft keyboard application, including parsing XML resources for physical keyboard translation and multi-tap sequences.

classes.name: ExternalAnyKeyboard
classes.description: A class representing an external keyboard layout with translation capabilities, parsing XML resources for physical keyboard mappings, and configuring key popups for an Android soft keyboard.

methods.name: createPhysicalTranslatorFromResourceId
methods.description: Creates and initializes a HardKeyboardSequenceHandler by parsing an XML resource defining physical keyboard translations, including sequences and multi-tap mappings.

methods.name: getKeyCodesFromPhysicalSequence
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string of key codes or key names into an array of integer key codes.

methods.name: getKeyboardId
methods.description: Determines the keyboard ID based on device orientation.

methods.name: getKeyboardName
methods.description: Returns the name of the keyboard.

methods.name: getKeyboardIconResId
methods.description: Returns the resource ID for the keyboard icon.

methods.name: getDefaultDictionaryLocale
methods.description: Returns the default locale string for the dictionary.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Returns the Locale object associated with the keyboard.

methods.name: translatePhysicalCharacter
methods.description: Translates a physical keyboard key event into a character using the translation mappings.

methods.name: isInnerWordLetter
methods.description: Determines if a key value is considered an inner word letter, including additional exceptions.

methods.name: getSentenceSeparators
methods.description: Returns the characters used as sentence separators.

methods.name: setupKeyAfterCreation
methods.description: Configures popup characters and resources for a key after its creation, based on its primary code.
